title: AI Engineer (Energy)
description:
John Cockerill, enablers of opportunities

Driven since 1817 by the entrepreneurial spirit and thirst for innovation of its founder, the John Cockerill Group develops large-scale technological solutions to meet the needs of our time: facilitating access to
low-carbon energies, enabling sustainable industrial production, preserving natural resources, contributing to greener mobility, enhancing security and installing essential infrastructures.

Its offer to companies, governments and communities consists of services and associated equipment for the sectors of energy, defense, industry, environment, transport and infrastructures.

With more than 8 200 employees, John Cockerill achieved a turnover of € 1.649 billion in 2025 in 27 countries, on 5 continents.

Location - Mumbai, India

Job Purpose

John Cockerill is a global engineering group founded in 1817 and headquartered in Seraing, Belgium, delivering large-scale technological equipment across energy, defense, and industry. John Cockerill Energy is executing a 2026–2030 IT, digital and Applied-AI transformation across Cooling, Energy Solutions and Energy Transition, including a shift from experimental agents to industrialized, governed AI products.
Working under the direction of the AI Product Manager, the AI Engineer transforms approved use cases into production-grade AI solutions while ensuring compliance with corporate AI governance, cybersecurity requirements, approved technology standards, and scalability expectations. The role combines AI engineering, software engineering, cloud architecture, prompt engineering, integration development, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Development
Design and develop AI applications, copilots, and multi-agent systems aligned with approved business requirements. • Build AI-powered assistants using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform and Azure Services. • Develop reusable AI components and shared frameworks. • Translate user stories and functional requirements into working AI solutions.

• Agentic AI Engineering
Design and develop multi-agent systems using approved architecture. • Implement orchestration frameworks, agent collaboration patterns, tool calling, memory management, and human-in-the-loop controls. • Design agent interfaces, workflows, guardrails, and monitoring capabilities. • Participate in architecture reviews and technical governance.

• Prompt Engineering & Model Development
Create, test, optimize, and document prompts. • Evaluate AI model performance. • Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. • Implement vector search and semantic retrieval capabilities. • Optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.

• Data & Integration Engineering
Integrate AI products with enterprise systems including SAP S/4HANA, JD Edwards, Planview, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365 and engineering platforms. • Design APIs and data pipelines. • Ensure secure handling of enterprise data.

• Cloud & Platform Engineering
Deploy solutions on approved cloud environments. • Implement CI/CD pipelines. • Configure
monitoring, logging, and alerting. • Support infrastructure automation and environment management.

• LLMOps / MLOps
Establish deployment pipelines for AI products. • Manage AI lifecycle activities: development, testing, validation, deployment, monitoring and retirement. • Monitor token consumption and cloud costs. • Implement model governance and version control.
• Security, Risk & Compliance
Ensure compliance with Group AI Policy, Energy AI Governance SOP, cybersecurity standards, data privacy requirements and EU AI Act requirements. • Participate in risk assessments and architecture reviews. • Support audit and compliance activities.

• Quality Assurance
Conduct model testing and validation. • Measure accuracy and business performance. • Execute AI evaluation frameworks. • Document known limitations and mitigation actions.
• Documentation & Knowledge Management

Maintain technical documentation. • Create architecture diagrams and deployment guides. • Produce support documentation and training materials. • Ensure solutions can be maintained independently of individual developers.

• Adoption & Continuous ImprovementSupport pilots, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and production rollouts. • Troubleshoot production issues. • Analyze usage patterns and user feedback. • Recommend enhancements that improve business outcomes.

Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

•Bachelor's / master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
•3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, or cloud solution development including 2+ years delivering AI/ML, GenAI, Copilot or advanced analytics solutions.
•Experience deploying enterprise solutions on Microsoft Azure.
•Experience working in global organizations and cross-functional teams.
•Energy, EPC, industrial manufacturing, engineering or capital-goods sector experience preferred.
Technical & Product Skills AI Engineering & Knowledge Systems
•Generative AI, LLMs and Agentic AI: design enterprise AI assistants and goal-oriented agents using foundation models, orchestration, tool integration, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
•RAG, vector databases and knowledge engineering: ground AI outputs in trusted enterprise content using embeddings, semantic search, metadata, taxonomies and structured knowledge repositories.
•Prompt engineering and AI evaluation: design, test and document prompts; assess AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, safety, latency, cost and business value. Microsoft AI, Cloud & Integration Platform
•Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI: prototype, evaluate, deploy and monitor governed AI applications using enterprise-managed models and approved Azure AI services.
•Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Graph API: build and govern copilots connected to Microsoft 365, enterprise permissions, workflows and collaboration data.
•Power Platform, Azure Functions and Logic Apps: create low-code automations, serverless components and integrations across Microsoft 365, APIs and enterprise systems.
Software Engineering, DevOps & Operations
•Python, REST APIs and JSON: develop AI services, integration utilities, automation components and structured data interfaces for enterprise systems.
•GitHub, CI/CD and software design patterns: manage version control, code reviews, automated deployments and reusable architectures for maintainable AI products.
•Azure Cloud, infrastructure as code and observability: deploy, monitor and operate AI workloads using secure, repeatable and auditable cloud environments.
•Security by design and FinOps: embed access control, data protection, secure coding, cost monitoring and resource optimization from design through production.

4. Behavioral Competencies

•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
•Innovation mindset with business focus
•Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
•Structured and disciplined approach to engineering
•Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
•Ownership mentality and continuous improvement mindset
•Ability to work independently in a global matrix organization

5.Travel & Work Arrangement

This role requires periodic travel to Europe to work directly with business-line and Group IT stakeholders. The position is based in the Navi Mumbai office, with a maximum of 2 days’ work-from-home per week as per discussion with the reporting manager.

title: AI Product Manager (Energy)
description:
John Cockerill, enablers of opportunities

Driven since 1817 by the entrepreneurial spirit and thirst for innovation of its founder, the John Cockerill Group develops large-scale technological solutions to meet the needs of our time: facilitating access to
low-carbon energies, enabling sustainable industrial production, preserving natural resources, contributing to greener mobility, enhancing security and installing essential infrastructures.

Its offer to companies, governments and communities consists of services and associated equipment for the sectors of energy, defense, industry, environment, transport and infrastructures.

With more than 8 200 employees, John Cockerill achieved a turnover of € 1.649 billion in 2025 in 27 countries, on 5 continents.

About the Role

John Cockerill is a global engineering group founded in 1817 and headquartered in Seraing, Belgium, delivering large-scale technological equipment across energy, defense, and industry. John Cockerill Energy is executing a 2026–2030 IT, digital and Applied-AI transformation across Cooling, Energy Solutions and Energy Transition, including a shift from experimental agents to industrialized, governed AI products. The AI Product Manager owns the AI product life cycle end-to-end — from opportunity and use-case definition, through prototyping and delivery, to adoption, ROI realization and responsible retirement. This is a business-facing product-leadership role — not a coding position — that sits at the intersection of business value, data readiness, multi-agent architecture and Group AI governance. This role ensures that every AI product has a named owner, a prioritized backlog, measurable business outcomes and full compliance with the Group Policies and the EU AI Act. Product ownership remains with the business, not the developers.

2. Key Responsibilities

• AI Product Strategy & Backlog Ownership

Own the vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for assigned AI products across the three business lines. Translate business priorities into product increments; balance value, effort, risk and data readiness. Maintain a transparent intake-to-Go/No-Go pipeline aligned with the Energy AI use-case portfolio.

• Use-Case Qualification & Value Realization

Identify, qualify and business-case AI opportunities (proposal & bid intelligence, engineering QA, contract intelligence, schedule risk, knowledge management, predictive maintenance). Define target KPIs, benefits baselines and ROI per product; track realized value and recommend scale, pivot or retire decisions.

• Delivery, Governance & Compliance

Act as the accountable Product Owner in the Multi-Agent AI Governance framework — no vacant roles, backups defined. Steer sprints with Applied AI engineers. Enforce architecture-review, production-readiness and sign-off gates with the ITBP, ICT, Security and Data owners; ensure EU AI Act documentation and Group AI-policy compliance.

• Adoption, Change & Enablement

Drive user adoption and workflow redesign so AI products land in daily work. Prepare adoption materials, champion networks and training; monitor usage (WAU/MAU), feedback and satisfaction. Partner with BL AI Leads to embed products into engineering, tendering, execution and services.

• Budget, Cost & Consumption Monitoring

Own the product-level budget: estimate build/run costs, track cloud, token, API and license consumption against forecast, and flag overruns. Maintain a per-product cost-and-ROI view for Energy Management and integrate FinOps discipline into the product life cycle.

• Stakeholder & Partner Management

Serve as the single point of contact between business stakeholders, Applied AI CoE, Group ICT and external partners Facilitate steering reviews, manage vendor scope and deliverables, and influence stakeholders across a global matrix without hierarchy.

3. Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience
•Bachelor's / master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business or a related field; MBA or product-management certification an advantage.
•9–12+ years in product management / product ownership, digital or IT delivery including at least 2 years in AI/ML, data, or digital product management.
•Proven ownership of AI / ML / GenAI or agentic products from concept to production and adoption, with measurable ROI.
•Experience in industrial, energy, EPC, engineering or capital-goods environments and global, multi-country matrix organizations.
•Exposure to carve-out / M&A integration or ERP / platform programs is an advantage.

Technical & Product Skills

•Core: Agile / Scrum product ownership, backlog & roadmap management, use-case qualification, value / ROI modelling, KPI definition, stakeholder storytelling.

•AI & Platform: GenAI & Agentic concepts (RAG, multi-agent orchestration, hooks/guardrails) Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, M365 / Power Platform, data-readiness assessment.

•Governance: EU AI Act, GDPR, architecture-review & production-readiness gates, RACI & sign-off discipline, FinOps / cost monitoring.

•Leadership: Executive stakeholder management, cross-functional influence without hierarchy, vendor / partner management, change & adoption leadership.

4. Preferred Credentials

•Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) / SAFe POPM
•PMP / PRINCE2 · Microsoft AI / Azure AI certifications
•Copilot Studio maker
•Sector experience in energy / cooling / HRSG / renewables / hydrogen / industrial equipment
•Carve-out / M&A integration exposure

5.Travel & Work Arrangement

This role requires periodic travel to Europe to work directly with business-line and Group IT stakeholders. The position is based in the Mumbai office, with a maximum of 2 days’ work-from-home per week as per discussion with the reporting manager.

6. Why Join

•Own AI products end-to-end — take flagship agentic products from pilot to industrialized, revenue- and productivity-impacting solutions across three business lines

•Shape a new Applied AI function — help build the Energy Applied AI Centre of Excellence and India AI Delivery Pod, defining how AI is governed, delivered and scaled.

•High visibility, real impact — a business-facing role reporting into the ITBP, engaging BL CEOs, contributing to the Group GenAI vision and the exposure across multiple geographies

Animé depuis 1817 par l'esprit d'entreprendre et la soif d'innovation de son fondateur, le Groupe John Cockerill développe des solutions technologiques à large échelle pour répondre aux besoins de son temps : faciliter l'accès aux énergies bas carbone, permettre une production industrielle durable, préserver les ressources naturelles, contribuer à une mobilité plus verte, renforcer la sécurité et installer des infrastructures essentielles.

Son offre aux entreprises, aux Etats et aux collectivités se traduit par des services et des équipements associés dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de la défense, de l'industrie, de l'environnement, des transports et des infrastructures. Avec plus de 8 000 collaborateurs, John Cockerill a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 1,417 milliard d'euros en 2024 dans 28 pays, sur 5 continents.

ARQUUS, entreprise du groupe John Cockerill, leader des solutions de mobilité terrestre. Dans ses différentes implantations locales, ARQUUS conçoit, fabrique et soutient toute une gamme de véhicules blindés légers.

Partenaire historique des armées, ARQUUS compte près de 25 000 véhicules de tous types en service au sein de l’armée de Terre française. Arquus participe à la réalisation de la nouvelle génération de véhicules de l’armée de Terre, le Griffon et le Jaguar dans le cadre du programme Scorpion, tout en assurant l’ensemble de la logistique des pièces et organes de rechange grâce à sa plateforme logistique Hub Arquus.

Au sein de la Direction Qualité et dans le cadre d'un départ en retraite, nous recrutons un(e) Référent Qualité Logiciels H/F
Le poste est basé à Versailles Satory (78) avec des déplacements occasionnels.

À ce titre, vous définissez, déployez et faites évoluer le référentiel qualité logiciel d'Arquus afin de garantir la conformité des développements aux exigences normatives, réglementaires et contractuelles.

Vous aurez pour missions :

- Définir, harmoniser et faire évoluer les processus d'ingénierie et d'assurance qualité logicielle au sein des différentes entités de l'entreprise.

- Structurer un modèle générique de gestion de projet logiciel, commun à l'ensemble des équipes, et l'intégrer au modèle de gestion de programme Arquus.

- Accompagner les équipes projets dans la mise en œuvre des processus qualité et veiller à leur bonne application tout au long du cycle de développement logiciel.

- Réaliser des audits internes afin d'évaluer la conformité des pratiques, d'identifier les écarts et de piloter les plans d'actions associés.

- Conduire des audits fournisseurs dans le cadre de qualifications, d'évaluations périodiques ou de problématiques qualité.

- Préparer, coordonner et accompagner les audits clients en représentant Arquus, tout en assurant le suivi des actions correctives.

- Promouvoir la culture qualité au sein de l'entreprise par des actions de sensibilisation, de formation et d'accompagnement des équipes.

- Assurer une veille sur les évolutions des normes, des référentiels et des bonnes pratiques applicables à l'ingénierie logicielle.

Vos atouts pour réussir :

- Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+5 en informatique, systèmes embarqués ou domaine équivalent et justifiez d'une expérience significative en développement logiciel, complétée par une expérience en assurance qualité logicielle.

- Une solide maîtrise des processus de développement logiciel (Cycle en V, Agile, méthodes hybrides) et des activités associées : gestion des exigences, gestion de configuration, gestion des modifications et gestion de projet.

- Une bonne connaissance des référentiels d'assurance qualité logicielle tels que AQAP 2210 et ISO/IEC 12207.

- Des connaissances des référentiels d'ingénierie système (ISO/IEC 15288, CMMI, ASPICE), de sûreté de fonctionnement (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, MIL-STD-882E) et de cybersécurité (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155/R156) constituent un véritable atout.

- Une expérience en développement logiciel, notamment en langage C et Structured Text (ST), idéalement dans le domaine des systèmes embarqués.

- Des connaissances en architecture électronique, calculateurs et microcontrôleurs sont appréciées.

- La maîtrise des outils Siemens Polarion et/ou Teamcenter constitue un plus.

- Un bon niveau d'anglais

Ce que nous vous offrons :

- Rejoindre une entreprise à la pointe de l’innovation, contribuer à des projets d’envergure et avoir l’opportunité de travailler sur des technologies avancées au service de la défense nationale.

- Un package salarial annuel brut auquel s’ajoute une prime sur objectifs collectifs, intéressement, participation, santé prévoyance, compte épargne temps, monétisation possible des jours du CET, participation aux frais de repas, abonnements transports collectifs pris en charge à 80 % ou indemnité transport individuel, primes de cooptation, activités sociales CSE...

- Un parcours d’intégration sur mesure en fonction de votre poste.

- De nombreuses possibilités d’évolution au sein du groupe.

Notre processus de recrutement

Après une analyse approfondie de votre candidature par nos équipes RH et opérationnelles, si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez convié(e) à un premier entretien en visioconférence avec un recruteur. Si cette étape est concluante, vous poursuivrez le processus par des entretiens en présentiel avec votre futur(e) manager et un membre de l’équipe RH.

Au regard de notre secteur d’activité, nos postes sont soumis à enquête administrative (contrôle primaire).

title: ARQUUS STAGE - Systèmes embarqués et cybersécurité
description:
ARQUUS est une filiale française du groupe John Cockerill spécialisée dans la fabrication et la réparation de véhicules militaires. Dans ses différentes implantations locales, ARQUUS conçoit, fabrique et soutient toute une gamme de véhicules blindés légers.
Partenaire historique des armées, ARQUUS compte près de 25 000 véhicules de tous types en service au sein de l’armée de Terre française. Arquus participe à la réalisation de la nouvelle génération de véhicules de l’avant de l’armée de Terre, le Griffon et le Jaguar dans le cadre du programme Scorpion, tout en assurant l’ensemble de la logistique des pièces et organes de rechange grâce à sa plateforme

Dans ce contexte, ARQUUS développe différents types de logiciels. A ce titre, ARQUUS souhaite définition, convevoir et développer une solution articulée autour de deux volets et recherche un.e stagiare en informatique dont l’objectif sera la mise en œuvre de ce type d’outil.

Missions principales

1. Durcissement d’une distribution Linux embarquée à partir de Yocto

Le ou la stagiaire interviendra sur une distribution Linux embarquée générée avec Yocto afin d’améliorer son niveau de sécurité.
Les travaux pourront notamment porter sur :

- l’analyse de l’architecture existante

- l’identification de la surface d’attaque du système

- la réduction des services, paquets et composants non nécessaires

- le renforcement de la configuration système

- l’amélioration de la gestion des comptes, droits, accès et mécanismes de démarrage

- la formalisation de recommandations de durcissement adaptées à un environnement embarqué

- la mise en place d’une méthode de validation du durcissement réalisé

2. Développement d’une sonde logicielle NIDS pour réseau CAN

Le stage comprend également le développement d’une solution de détection d’intrusion sur réseau CAN, organisée en deux composants :

Front-end de gestion des règles de détection

Développé pour un usage sur PC, ce composant permettra de :

- créer des règles de détection

- générer et structurer un jeu de règles exploitable

- modifier, ajouter, supprimer et versionner les règles

- importer/exporter des règles

- préparer un format de déploiement compatible avec la cible embarquée

Back-end embarqué en C

Déployé au sein d’un calculateur embarqué connecté à un réseau CAN véhicule, ce composant aura pour rôle de :

- charger les règles produites par le front-end

- appliquer ces règles en temps réel ou quasi temps réel sur les trames CAN observées

- détecter des événements ou comportements suspects

- remonter les alertes associées selon un format défini

- respecter les contraintes embarquées de performance, de robustesse et d’empreinte logicielle

Objectifs techniques du stage

Le stage vise à produire des résultats concrets et exploitables, parmi lesquels :

- une première base de distribution Linux embarquée durcie sous Yocto

- une architecture logicielle claire pour la sonde NIDS

- un moteur embarqué en C capable d’interpréter et d’appliquer des règles de détection sur trafic CAN

- un outil front-end permettant l’administration de ces règles

- un format d’échange propre entre front-end et back-end

- un jeu de scénarios de test et de validation

- une documentation technique et d’utilisation

Activités détaillées

Selon le niveau d’avancement et le profil du stagiaire, les activités pourront inclure :

- étude bibliographique et état de l’art sur le durcissement Linux embarqué et la détection d’intrusion sur bus CAN

- définition de l’architecture technique de la solution

- spécification du format des règles de détection

- développement du moteur de traitement embarqué en C

- développement du front-end de gestion de règles

- intégration sur cible embarquée

- mise en place de tests fonctionnels et techniques

- essais sur trafic CAN nominal et scénarios d’anomalies

- analyse des performances, de la consommation de ressources et des limites de la solution

- rédaction de documentation et restitution des travaux

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2 avec un fort intérêt pour les systèmes embarqués et la cybersécurité.

Compétences attendues

- bonnes bases en développement C

- connaissances en Linux

- intérêt marqué pour le logiciel embarqué

- attrait pour la cybersécurité et les problématiques de durcissement

- capacité à comprendre une architecture technique complète, du poste de développement jusqu’à la cible embarquée

Compétences appréciées

- connaissance de Yocto

- notions sur les réseaux CAN

- expérience en développement d’outils PC ou d’interfaces de configuration

- notions de protocoles, de détection d’anomalies ou de cybersécurité système

- pratique de scripts d’automatisation ou d’outils de test

Qualités recherchées

- curiosité technique

- rigueur

- autonomie progressive

- esprit d’analyse

- capacité à documenter clairement son travail

- envie de travailler sur un sujet concret, à la frontière entre système, embarqué et cyber

Apports du stage

Ce stage permet de travailler sur un sujet particulièrement formateur, combinant :

- Linux embarqué et construction système avec Yocto

- durcissement logiciel et système

- cybersécurité véhicule

- réseau CAN

- développement logiciel multi-composants

- conception d’une solution complète, du poste PC jusqu’au calculateur embarqué

Le ou la stagiaire sera amené(e) à manipuler des problématiques des enjeux industriels réels : contraintes de ressources, sécurité, robustesse, déploiement, maintenabilité et validation.

L’objectif est de permettre au stagiaire de monter rapidement en compétence tout en lui donnant un cadre structuré, des objectifs progressifs et une vraie visibilité sur la finalité industrielle de ses travaux.

Livrables attendus

À titre indicatif, les livrables attendus en fin de stage sont :

- dossier d’architecture de la solution

- distribution ou configuration Yocto durcie

- code source du back-end embarqué

- code source ou prototype du front-end de gestion des règles

- format de règles documenté

- plan de test et résultats de validation

- documentation d’installation, d’usage et de maintenance

- rapport de stage et support de présentation

title: Comptable Medior
description:
Comptable Medior LU – John Cockerill Corporate

Êtes-vous prêt à contribuer à un groupe industriel mondial qui façonne les solutions durables de demain ?

Animé depuis 1817 par l'esprit d'entreprise et la soif d'innovation de son fondateur, le groupe John Cockerill développe des solutions technologiques à grande échelle pour répondre aux besoins de son époque : faciliter l'accès aux énergies à faible émission de carbone, permettre une production industrielle durable, préserver les ressources naturelles, contribuer à une mobilité plus verte, renforcer la sécurité et installer des infrastructures critiques.

Son offre aux entreprises, aux États et aux collectivités comprend des services et des équipements associés pour les secteurs de l'énergie, de la défense, de l'industrie, de l'environnement, des transports et des infrastructures.

Avec plus de 8 000 employés, John Cockerill a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 1,417 milliard d'euros en 2024, opérant dans 28 pays sur 5 continents.

En tant que groupe international diversifié, John Cockerill s'appuie sur des fonctions corporate solides pour soutenir ses activités, stimuler la performance, assurer la gouvernance et favoriser une croissance durable dans toutes ses activités.

Pourquoi rejoindre John Cockerill ?

• Impact au niveau du groupe : contribuez à des fonctions stratégiques, transversales ou de soutien ayant un impact direct sur les performances commerciales.

• Portée internationale : collaborez avec des équipes et des parties prenantes issues de différentes régions, entreprises et cultures.

👉 Découvrez nos talents internationaux : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CvUiEakGcsQ&t=72s

• Environnement axé sur les objectifs : faites partie d'un groupe engagé dans le développement durable, l'innovation et la création de valeur à long terme.

• Autonomie et confiance : évoluez dans une culture qui valorise la responsabilité, l'initiative et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée.

Pour soutenir sa croissance et sa transformation continues, John Cockerill investit dans une solide expertise d'entreprise, alliant vision stratégique, excellence opérationnelle et valeurs humaines.

Votre rôle

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités, au sein du Shared Service Comptable France, John Cockerill recherche un Comptable Medior H/F rattaché à notre site de Mondorf les Bains à Luxembourg.
Pleinement intégré dans l’équipe du Centre de Services Partagés du Luxembourg, le Comptable Sénior (H/F) gère de manière autonome et polyvalente l’ensemble des tâches comptables pour un portefeuille composé de plusieurs sociétés, majoritairement basées en France.

Vos responsabilités principales

- Ses responsabilités consistent principalement en la production de clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et semestrielles, déclarations de TVA et liasses fiscales et autres déclarations fiscales périodiques, ainsi que la supervision de la comptabilité courante jusqu’à l’établissement des Etats Financiers.

- En contact régulier avec les différents contrôleurs de gestion des entités dont il a la charge, il en gère la comptabilité analytique.

- Il est également en relation avec les services Consolidation et Tax du groupe.

- A terme, le superviseur comptable développera son expertise sur un ou plusieurs domaines transversaux permettant d’amener son support au reste de l’équipe sur les thématiques concernées.

Dans le cadre de ses missions, le Comptable Sénior (H/F) dépend directement du Responsable de la Comptabilité Générale, basé au Luxembourg.

Votre équipe Finance

Vous intégrerez une équipe collaborative et transversale, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des experts comptables, des représentants commerciaux et des parties prenantes de haut niveau.

La culture d'entreprise favorise le partage des connaissances, le travail d'équipe et l'amélioration continue, soutenus par un style de management basé sur la confiance, l'autonomie et une communication claire.

Votre profil

Experience & Compétences Techniques

- Être titulaire, au minimum d’un BAC +4 en comptabilité Française

- Justifier d’une expérience de 2 à 5 ans, idéalement en secteur industriel.

- Maitriser parfaitement la comptabilité générale française, ainsi que disposer d’une connaissance de la comptabilité analytique et de la fiscalité française

- Disposer d’une expérience probante avec le logiciel SAP

Compétences Personnelles & Soft Skills

- Orientation client, souci d’offrir en permanence un service de qualité aux entités clientes internes

- Capacité à travailler en complète autonomie et à prendre les initiatives nécessaires au bon déroulement des dossiers

- Capacité à travailler en équipe et à respecter les méthodes de travail

- Diplomatie, bonnes capacités d’écoute et de communication

- Planification, organisation, structure et grande rigueur dans le travail

- Capacité à faire face et à s’adapter aux changements

- Autonomie dans son propre travail et capacité à encadrer des membres de l’équipe moins expérimentés

- Discrétion exemplaire au vu des informations sensibles mises à disposition

- Maîtrise des outils de la suite Microsoft Office et de SAP (la connaissance de SAP S4/HANA est un plus)

- La connaissance de l’Anglais ou de l’Allemand est un plus

Ce que nous offrons Chez John Cockerill, Nous Valorisons Votre Contribution

Un package salarial compétitif avec :

- Un salaire annuel brut entre 50k et 55k (selon profil)

- Statut Cadre, 40 heures du lundi au vendredi (journée)

- 29 jours de Congés Payés

- Des tickets restaurant (Valeur faciale 12€)

- Mutuelle prise en charge par l’employeur

Quelles sont les prochaines étapes ?

• Premier entretien avec Julien Reijmen

• Rencontre sur place ou virtuelle avec Marie Frans, Joelle Dedon et Laurence Maitrejean

Leveraging strong engineering capabilities, the company also delivers high-value after-sales services such as re-engineering, technical assistance, inspections, upgrades and lifetime assessments. Committed to the energy transition, John Cockerill Energy develops integrated, engineer-driven solutions combining renewable generation, energy storage and advanced Energy Management Systems (EMS).

John Cockerill Energy, The Power to Change the World.

Why join John Cockerill Energy?

- Meaningful impact: contribute to energy projects directly supporting decarbonization and energy efficiency.

- Global reach: collaborate with multicultural teams and international suppliers on complex projects worldwide.

- Supportive environment: benefit from a culture of flexibility, autonomy, collaboration and work-life balance.

- Engineering & decision centers on the same site: evolve in an agile, engineering-driven environment enabling fast and informed decisions.

- Technical expertise: develop your expertise within a highly technical procurement environment and become a key reference for your purchasing portfolio.

Because the energy transition requires reliable, efficient and sustainable technologies, John Cockerill Energy continuously innovates to deliver solutions combining performance, safety and environmental responsibility.

Your role

As a Deputy Expediting Manager, you will play a key role within the Supply Chain of the John Cockerill projects. The Deputy Expediting Manager is the right-hand (wo)man of the Expediting Manager who ensures that products and equipment purchased for international projects are delivered on time by our suppliers.

This role includes managerial support for the Expediting Manager and regular travel to suppliers to ensure good progress and coordination with the project teams.

The Deputy Expediting Manager takes in charge scopes of material supplies for the internal stakeholders. The Deputy Expediting should work in close collaboration with lead buyers, project management department, QA/QC teams, HSE teams, Engineering dept., etc.

Your key responsibilities

As a Deputy Expediting Manager, you will

- Ensure that our suppliers execute correctly the purchase orders placed by John Cockerill in accordance with contracts terms and conditions, following our procedures and quality requirements

- Be responsible for the follow-up of all the steps of orders fulfilment by the suppliers and their sub-contractors

- Ensure to obtain all information regarding updating of progress documents, the allocation and distribution of the tasks, the schedule and you will keep track of the real time progress of the manufacturing status and delivery status of the scopes assigned to you

- Anticipate the risks of possible delays by analyzing information received from the suppliers, obtained by yourself or all other stakeholders

- Take necessary measures that will ensure suppliers and subcontractors keep or get back on track and make sure that the essential project deadlines are met. This will include follow-up visits to suppliers/sub-suppliers or progress meetings

- Provide managerial support occasionally to the Expediting Manager: organization of team meetings, workload forecast, structural improvement of dunning processes, negotiation with key partners, documents management, etc.

- Evaluate suppliers on several criteria on performance and assist new suppliers in their integration for a sustainable partnership

- Contribute to improvement of the suppliers’ evaluation process and take the lead of it

- Organize external third-party visits through worldwide agents

- Give feedback to all different departments at John Cockerill (project teams, QA team, procurement teams, etc.) but even to the suppliers

- Protect John Cockerill’s interests by ensuring compliance with contractual terms and conditions.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of procurement & expediting processes and their interaction with other business processes.

- Ensure compliance with John Cockerill’s governance, ethics and sustainable development principles.

Your team

You will join a small team of expeditors included in an approximately 20-person supply chain team

The team is organized around projects and purchasing specialties, with buyers taking responsibility for specific technical equipment categories such as valves, piping, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, cables and other components.

You will work closely with colleagues based in Belgium and India and interact regularly with international suppliers and stakeholders.

The team operates in a collaborative, open and supportive environment, where knowledge sharing and teamwork are highly valued. At the same time, the position offers significant autonomy in managing your own portfolio, priorities and supplier relationships.

You will be based in Seraing, Belgium.

Your profile

- You have a master’s degree in mechanical engineering, or equivalent professional experience in procurement and follow-up on manufacturing for industrial construction projects

- You have a minimum of 7-10 years of relevant experience in a project-oriented industrial environment.

- You are a team player, initiative taker and are willing to take and carry responsibilities.

- You have excellent social and communication skills

- You can understand technical documentation, specifications and plans and assess how technical characteristics can influence cost and supplier selection.

- You have a strong understanding of procurement processes and stakeholder coordination.

- You have skills for people management and conflict handling.

- You have tact, diplomacy, respect and ability to adapt to people at all levels in an organization and/or with different cultural backgrounds

- You can manage your own priorities and agenda in a dynamic, sometimes fast-paced project environment.

- You have excellent communication and negotiation skills.

- You are transparent, open-honest and have a high level of integrity

- You are willing to travel regularly and available for short-term temporary assignments abroad

Languages

- Fluent English & French are mandatory, both written and spoken.

- Knowledge of another language is considered an asset.

- International openness is essential.

International mobility

You are willing to travel regularly for supplier visits, audits and face-to-face meetings, including internationally.

What we offer

At John Cockerill, we deeply value your contribution:

- Attractive salary package with many extra-legal benefits: company car, meal vouchers, flat-rate expenses, hospitalization/life/death/guaranteed income insurance, variable remuneration ranging from 0–25% of your gross annual salary, profit-sharing scheme based on progress and results.

- Flexible work arrangements, with 1–2 days of remote work per week after training.

- Comprehensive onboarding and training with plenty of learning opportunities.

- Career development: regular reviews, large catalogue of training, and career progression.

- International opportunities: potential to evolve within your sector, across different sectors or businesses, and across different regions.

- 31 days off.

The Project Manager works together with the Head Offices project teams (based in Belgium or in USA). He/she will be the single point of contact for the Head Office project team for the identified work packages. For reporting, coordination and project management activities related to a particular Project, the Project Manager will report to the Project Manager/Technical Project Manager of the related Project, in Head Office.

He/she is responsible for ensuring that the Design Process is applied as defined in the QMS of the Energy Solutions Business line. Other activities, such as coordination and follow up of procurement, shipment,… will be progressively part of responsibilities.

The Project Manager will be responsible for the quality/compliance of the deliverables, the delivery time of these deliverables (either engineering or products).

Key Responsibilities

- Coordination with internal teams to ensure full compliance of the work packages attributed by Head Office Project Management to the Indian Execution Center:

- compliance with the HO specifications and technical notes.

- compliance with the constraints and specifications from the Project Contract.

- compliance with Project schedule in terms of timing (early completion) and resources consumption.

- compliance with the costs and margins.

- compliance with procedures (ISO 9000, ISO 14000, VCA, etc.).

- Organization of coordination meetings with relevant teams from John Cockerill office, Vendor and Head Office Project Management with follow up of action lists.

- Provide continuous, clear and updated reporting to the Head Office Project team, including progress, expected or actual completion, consumption of resources for work packages to Head Office Project Management through the intense use of Primavera scheduling (P6 or Primavera Cloud).

- For the scope attributed to Indian Execution Center for a particular project, the Project Manager is responsible for:

- Preparation of RFQ (Request for Quotation) packages for the Procurement department based on inputs from Engineering.

- Technical compliance verification and resolution of queries with Suppliers.

- Follow up and expediting of the Suppliers awarded: engineering deliverables of the Suppliers (timing and quality) and manufacturing/delivery progress.

- Key point of contact for mechanical erection and commissioning advisors on site;

- Optimization and follow-up of the financial results of the scope of the project, including but not limited to estimation of “to complete” budget per WBS, update of Cash data; cash flow requirement for the scope handled.

- Technical and Supply Chain risks and opportunities assessments and reporting, including mitigation/corrective action plans;

- Application of internal standards and good practices.

- Continuously challenge, analyze, and monitor BOQ (weight, unit price, total price) for the ongoing project(s) across different phases: proposal, engineering, procurement, design, and supplier feedback.

- Promotion of quality, efficiency and productivity to meet business objectives and goals.

- Adhere to project schedules and expected hours for the projects. Ensure the schedule is up-to-date and critical activities are under control.

In this function, the Project Manager will have a global view on the projects, from basic engineering to 3D modeling to fabrication to the final site construction of the product.

The Project Manager reports to the Energy Solutions India Operation Manager. Daily, his/her ‘internal customer’ will be the Head Offices project Teams.

- 10 to 14 years with minimum 5-7 years of Applicable Experience (as Project Engineer in EP/EPC projects)

- B.E. Mechanical

- Analysis of contractual requirements in regards with internal standards as well as application of internal technical choices

- Understanding of international codes and norms (mainly ASME, EN and ISO)

- Understanding of basic design of the products of the business line

- Understanding of P&ID’s and product processes

- Ability to read mechanical and electrical drawings

- Knowledge of the PMBOK principle is a strong advantage.

- Understanding of product and organization interfaces

- Fluent knowledge of English is mandatory,

- Leadership & Coaching: you know how to inspire and motivate your team in an assertive way

- Organization & Coordination: you work with different functions and different suppliers, with deadlines to meet

- Communication & Presentation: it’s your daily job to create bonds and to pass on information, and you can even do it internationally

- Decision-making & Problem-solving: you are often confronted with different options, for which some unknowns remain

- Working under pressure: you must make decisions… It is not always easy with high value projects. But you know risk-taking is sometimes necessary to move the project forward and you can handle it!

- Global viewer: large-scale projects require a broad vision

You can't master everything! Count on our onboarding period (3 to 6 months) to meet your colleagues and their role, as well as to get familiar with our internal standards, our tools, our processes.

John Cockerill Energy, a player in the energy transition: the strength of a diversified and combinable range of solutions

It is from the heart of its history stretching back more than 200 years that John Cockerill Energy draws its expertise in the production of steam, which has led to it being recognized worldwide on the market for the conception and supply of heat recuperation boilers. Resolutely turned towards the future. We proudly incarnate the bold spirit of an entrepreneur and we have extended our know-how to respond to the needs of our times, by developing innovative solutions to encourage access to energy, just like our founder in his own times:

- Industrial boilers destined for sectors such as chemicals, petrochemicals, biomass, incineration, …

It is from this knowledgeable mix of tradition and innovation that we draw our own energy. And it is across the whole world that John Cockerill Energy makes its mark through its technological know-how and its mastery of project management thanks to our Belgian, American and Mexican teams and our recuperation boiler licensees, Wuxi, S&T and Larsen & Toubro which respectively cover China, South Korea and India. Job Purpose

Overview

The Quality Engineer is a working employee who is a key representative of the project team, and also of the Customers and Suppliers, for all topics related to project quality aspect. He/She is in charge of the completeness and compliance to the contract of the quality documentation of the project from the award of an order to the provisional acceptance of the equipment. The Quality Engineer is particularly responsible to issue the ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) of the project and to follow up the quality documentation of the Suppliers taking an important part in the Supply Chain Process as defined in the QMS (Quality Management System) of the Energy Sector.

The Quality Engineer is responsible to verify that all required tests have been performed as per the Standards and the contract. As per the hold and witness points of the ITP, he/she could possibly assist to the inspections and tests (pressure, functional and performance tests) at the Suppliers’ facility.

He/she will review and comment all the quality documentation of all purchased commodities.

He/she will issue the quality release for each equipment when the required quality level demanded by the project is met.

Objectives

The Quality Engineer is responsible for the quality of the products purchased for the project he/she is in charge. He/she will also be responsible of the review of the quality documentation of the purchased products. He/she is under the hierarchical responsibility of the Quality Manager and the functional responsibility of the Project Manager with the following objectives:

- Customer satisfaction,

- Conformance to applicable codes and norms, directives, contractual scope of supply, Customer’s technical specifications, internal standards and local regulations, in regards to the quality of the equipment and the fabrication

- Quality, conformity and completeness of the quality documentation,

- Respect of timely quality documentation issuance and review of delivery schedules.

Key Responsibilities

The duties of the Quality Engineer are amongst others:

- Analysis of contractual quality specifications,

- Privilege contact of the project team for all quality aspects,

- Defend John Cockerill’s interests in an appropriate way in front of Customers and Suppliers,

- Development and issue of the Inspection and Tests Plans of the projects he/she is assigned,

- Writing of quality specifications (additional requirements on raw materials, fabrication procedures, repair procedures…),

- Participation to technical negotiations and kick-off meeting (KOM) with Suppliers,

- Participation to kick-off meeting with Customers for quality aspects,

- Check of the conformity of quality documentation of Suppliers (Quality Plans, WPS/PQR, NDT procedures, NDT reports…) during project execution from KOM to the completion of the MDB (Manufacturing Data Book),

- Follow up of inspection notifications and coordination/participation with Customers with project management,

- Participate to inspections and tests at Suppliers’ Yard when judged necessary.

- Privilege contact of local workshop Quality Supervisors,

- Follow up of non-conformities and action plans of Suppliers,

- Issue of Quality Release reports,

- Privilege contact of Site Supervisor for all site quality issues,

- Ensure appliance certification of the equipment stamping such as (but not limited) ASME stamp and CE marking when applicable.

- Coordination of possible Third Parties (AI, NoBo…) involved in the project,

- Preparation of the documentation for regulation registration of products (National Board for instance),

- When applicable, verification that all the documentation required by the code/norm or directive are reviewed by the third party (AI for ASME, NoBo for PED…)

- Participation to qualification process of new Suppliers,

- Technical risks assessments,

- Application of internal standards and good practices,  Promotion and implementation of continuous improvement.

The Quality Engineer reports directly to the Quality Manager.

Education & Experience

- 10-15 years’ experience

- Bachelor of Engineering (Welding Technology / Mechanical / Production / Metallurgy / Material)  Certification from AWS / AM-IIW in Welding Technology

Background, Skills and Competencies

The Quality Engineer has a generalist profile. He/she must be available for temporary missions, sometimes on short notice, including international travel.

He/she adheres to the essential values of John Cockerill:

- Human

- Committed

- Innovative

- Responsible  Customer oriented

His/her soft skills are:

- Team spirit

- Information sharing

- Collaboration

- Detailed focus

- Decision taking

- Rigorous

- Results oriented

- Organized

- Schedule oriented

- Problem solving

- Comfortable with international contacts and relationships

- Ability to work under pressure

- Assertiveness

His/her technical skills are:

- Analysis of contractual requirements in regards with internal standards (mainly ASME, EN and ISO codes)

- Understanding of international codes and norms

- Understanding of international regulations for John Cockerill’s products (mainly

European Pressure Equipment Directive and ASME)

- Knowledge on steel material properties

- Knowledge of welding processes

- Knowledge of NDT (Non Destructive Testing)

- Ability to read mechanical and electrical drawings

- Application of internal technical choices

- Understanding of his professional environment

- Understanding of product and organization interfaces

- Fluent in English (reading, speaking, listening)

- Fluent in French is a plus

Who We Are

John Cockerill Energy, a player in the energy transition: the strength of a diversified and combinable range of solutions

It is from the heart of its history stretching back more than 200 years that John Cockerill Energy draws its expertise in the production of steam, which has led to it being recognized worldwide on the market for the conception and supply of heat recuperation boilers. Resolutely turned towards the future. - The manufacture and maintenance of boiler parts, in particular pressure parts in its specialized workshop based in Mexico.

- Aftersales services, technical assistance, inspections from the rehabilitation to the modernization of all types and brands of boilers.

- Wet & dry cooling with cooling towers and air-cooled condensers for power plants.

- Thermal solar receivers (Concentrated Solar Power), that capture the sun’s rays, reflected by mirrors on the ground, and enable to produce energy 24/7 thanks to molten salts.

- Industrial boilers destined for sectors such as chemicals, petrochemicals, biomass, incineration, …

It is from this knowledgeable mix of tradition and innovation that we draw our own energy. And it is across the whole world that John Cockerill Energy makes its mark through its technological know-how and its mastery of project management thanks to our Belgian, American and Mexican teams and our recuperation boiler licensees, Wuxi, S&T and Larsen & Toubro which respectively cover China, South Korea and India.
